units.title: Unit 1 — Alphabet, Basic Sounds & Closed Syllables

lessons.title: The English Alphabet & Letter Names vs Sounds
grammar: Distinction between letter name (A = /eɪ/) and letter sound (A = /æ/)
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-PRON-A1-001"
cando: "Can name the 26 letters of the alphabet and produce basic short vowel sounds."
task: "Spell name and pronounce 5 basic CVC words."
speaking_focus: "Clear mouth positioning for short vowels."

lessons.title: Short Vowels in CVC Closed Syllables
grammar: Short vowel rule in closed syllables (consonant-vowel-consonant)
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-PRON-A1-002"
cando: "Can decode and pronounce 1-syllable CVC words accurately."
task: "Minimal pairs: cat vs cut, sit vs set, hot vs hat."
speaking_focus: "Vowel contrast and mouth opening."

lessons.title: Basic Consonant Digraphs (SH, CH, TH, PH, WH, NG, CK)
grammar: Two-letter consonant combinations producing a single sound
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-PRON-A1-003"
cando: "Can identify and pronounce core consonant digraphs."
task: "Discriminate voiceless TH vs voiced TH."
speaking_focus: "Tongue placement between teeth for TH."

units.title: Unit 2 — Long Vowels, Silent E & Vowel Teams

lessons.title: Magic E / Silent E Rule (Vowel-Consonant-e)
grammar: Long vowel lengthening caused by final silent e
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-PRON-A1-004"
cando: "Can contrast short and long vowels using Magic E pairs."
task: "Read pairs: hop/hope, tap/tape, bit/bite, tub/tube."
speaking_focus: "Vowel lengthening and silent e dropping."

lessons.title: Basic Vowel Teams (EE, EA, AI, AY, OA, OW, OO)
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-PRON-A1-005"
cando: "Can read vowel teams using position heuristics."
task: "Identify AI mid-word vs AY at end of word."
speaking_focus: "Pure long vowel and diphthong production."

lessons.title: Basic Silent Letters (KN, WR, MB, GN)
grammar: Silent initial and final consonants of Germanic origin
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-PRON-A1-006"
cando: "Can suppress silent initial k, w, g and final b."
task: "Read list of silent-letter words without pronouncing silent letters."
speaking_focus: "Immediate transition to the sounding consonant."

lessons.title: Plural and Third-Person S Endings
grammar: Phonological conditioning of final -s / -es based on preceding voicing
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-PRON-A1-007"
cando: "Can correctly apply /s/, /z/, and /iz/ to plurals and verbs."
task: "Sort words into 3 sound columns."
speaking_focus: "Voicing contrast on final sibilants."

lessons.title: Past Tense ED Endings
grammar: Phonological conditioning of regular past tense -ed
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-PRON-A1-008"
cando: "Can pronounce regular past tense verbs with correct endings."
task: "Identify extra syllable added only after /t/ and /d/."
speaking_focus: "Avoiding extra syllable on /t/ and /d/ endings."
